Overlooked clause that changes the outcome: POL-RD-10(5) escalates where 'an exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool, OR DOES NOT COVER THE TRIP WINDOW, or lacks the field the clause requires'. The driver invokes the PIE closure (POL-RD-03); the only closure advisory, EV-ADVIS-04012-01, is valid 2026-10-03T23:59 to 2026-10-04T05:00 and does not cover the 07:51:10-08:19:13 trip window. A careful reader can therefore ESCALATE under RD-10(5) instead of failing RD-03(b) and ruling NO_ACTION: two defensible answers. POL-RD-13 does not resolve it (it addresses only a MISSING advisory and says it does not narrow RD-10(5) where the party cites the artifact). The intent's 'RD-10: No trigger: advisories present and populated' misses this limb.

Second RD-10(5) hook: both advisories carry shortest_lawful_alternative_km null, the field RD-03's cap formula requires, so a reader can also say the cited artifact 'lacks the field the clause requires'.
fixes: Keep the ruling (NO_ACTION), difficulty (REVERSAL), the trace, fare and the 5.50 refund. Replace EV-ADVIS-04012-01 with an advisory that COVERS the trip window but names a PIE section the booked route never uses, so RD-03 fails on limb (a) ('covering a corridor the optimal route never uses, does not exonerate anything') and RD-10(5) has nothing to bite on. Suggested payload: type ROADWORKS (or CLOSURE), road 'PIE', segment 'PIE (towards Tuas) between the Adam Road exit and the Bukit Timah Road exit, lanes closed for resurfacing', geometry about (1.3299, 103.8150) -> (1.3335, 103.8040), valid_from 2026-10-04T06:00:00+08:00, valid_to 2026-10-04T12:00:00+08:00, issued_at 2026-10-01T15:00:00+08:00, shortest_lawful_alternative_km non-null (e.g. 14.6, the booked distance, since the booked route is unaffected). Populate shortest_lawful_alternative_km on EV-ADVIS-04012-02 too (non-null), or drop that advisory: it lies on the driver's own TPE route and only adds a 'lacks the field' hook if an advocate invokes it.

Keep the driver's claim 'PIE was closed at Eunos, got LTA notice ...' (now contradicted on location: the only PIE notice concerns a section west of the booked exit) and the rider's 'The PIE was open that morning'.
